message: **Answer**: This introductory video aims to explain the concept of "programming" and its importance in the modern world. It emphasizes that learning to program allows users to interact with computers effectively.  Python is highlighted as an excellent choice due to its ease of learning, widespread usage, and power. The video encourages viewers to actively engage with the process by starting to code immediately through hands-on experience rather than relying solely on theory. By combining practical coding sessions with explanations, the instructor intends to guide learners towards fluency in Python programming.
